mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, we have clear skies with a temperature of 49 degrees at the Verona Area High School, though it feels a bit cooler at 45 degrees.

The City of Verona continues its contract for engineering services with AECOM Inc., and the public is invited to attend meetings regarding the US 18/151 Corridor Study on November 18 or 19 to review initial design concepts.
We have plenty going on, starting with Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory all happening today.
Looking at the weekly report, on October 25, a 40-year-old man was arrested for an O W I, first offence, after officers discovered him stopped at an intersection for an extended period.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy some Chocolate Heath Crunch, and you can pick some up when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
